messages:
Aisha: Need quick approval to push a hotfix to request-queue in prod-apac. Fix addresses a rare dequeue stall under burst load. Image: `request-queue:3.2.1-hf1`. We're inside a maintenance window but partners are impacted. @Tom @Rowan @ops_oncall please ack.
Tom: What's the rollback plan and canary strategy?
Aisha: Rollback is simple: pin back to `request-queue:3.2.0`. Plan: small canary 5% for 3m, then 25% for 4m, then 100% if green. If dequeue-failures > 0.4% on any slice -> rollback. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/request-queue.
Rowan: Approve 5% canary. Add: enable verbose metrics for canary pods for 5m.
ops_oncall: I'll monitor queue-depth, dequeue-failures, and latency. If queue-depth rises unexpectedly I'll cut traffic back. Approve.
deploybot: [deploybot] Canary start requested for request-queue:3.2.1-hf1 in prod-apac (5%) at 1767778902. Checks: health, dequeue_failures, queue_depth, p95_latency.
Aisha: Kicking off canary now. Notifying PM @pm_leo to prep customer note if we escalate.
pm_leo: On standby to send brief partner update post-cutover.
deploybot: [deploybot] Canary progressed to 25% at 1767778918. Canary metrics: dequeue_failures=0.00%, queue_depth stable, p95 latency +0.5%.
Tom: Looks good. Approve move to 100% if no regressions in next 6m.
Rowan: Approve final.
ops_oncall: Approve with rollback trigger set as discussed. I'll execute rollback if needed.
deploybot: [deploybot] Rollout to 100% completed at 1767778939. Post-rollout checks: all green.
Aisha: Post-deploy note: observed transient warm-up with p95 +1% for 2 mins then stabilized. dequeue_failures remained 0.0%. Keeping enhanced monitoring for 20m.
pm_leo: Drafting partner note: "Hotfix deployed to request-queue to resolve rare dequeue stall. Initial telemetry nominal; monitoring continues."
Aisha: Marking this thread resolved unless we see anomalies. Thanks :rocket:
